displayName: OCI-API-007: API7: Server-Side Request Forgery via API
description:
Detects SSRF attempts through API endpoints targeting internal networks or cloud metadata

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_007", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%api7%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%server%') AND "value" > 0
